source_definition: A source instance is an explicitly encoded Boolean formula with at most three literals per clause. Its outputs are satisfying Boolean assignments, or NO-SOLUTION when the formula is unsatisfiable.
target_definition: Given a nonempty rational matrix M and nonnegative integer budget b, find real A,B with M=A⊙B and rank(A)+rank(B)≤b, or report NO-SOLUTION. Witnesses encode both rank factorizations over one real algebraic primitive element; zero widths and either factor order are allowed.
required_result: Construct deterministic polynomial-time maps F and G: F sends every legal source instance to a legal target instance, and G(x,y) is a valid source output for every valid output y of F(x). Preserve the stated threshold, domain and promises. The requested complexity conclusion is NP-hardness for the stated target problem.
